note: Accessibility navigation shortcuts -- renders: Skip to main content, Skip to about this item, Skip to buying options, Skip to reviews, Search, Cart, Home, Your orders, Show shortcuts

Main navigation bar -- renders: Amazon logo, Search, All, Today's Deals, Customer Service, Returns & Orders, Cart, and fixed category links; excludes user-specific account, order, cart, and location data
Secondary navigation bar -- renders: fixed category links like Today's Deals, Customer Service, Returns & Orders
Site footer -- renders: Back to top, Get to Know Us, Careers, Blog, Investor Relations, Amazon Devices, Make Money with Us, Let Us Help You, and legal links
Product image gallery controls -- renders: image thumbnails and navigation buttons
Buy box controls -- renders: Add to Cart, Add to List, and availability status buttons
Review rating histogram -- renders: Customer reviews, star rating distribution, and filter controls
Media carousel heading -- renders: Customer images and videos
Link to all reviews -- renders: See all reviews
Product comparison table -- renders: Compare with similar items, attribute labels, and product links
Average customer reviews summary -- renders: star rating icon and review count link
Availability status -- renders: In Stock, Out of Stock, or shipping availability text
Ships from and sold by labels -- renders: Ships from, Sold by, and merchant name
Product feature bullets -- renders: bullet points describing product features
Tell Amazon about a lower price -- renders: link to report lower price
Energy efficiency information -- renders: energy efficiency rating and details
Product generations widget -- renders: newer version available expander
Product overview section -- renders: product overview heading and content
Product description and marketing copy -- renders: product description, features, and marketing content
Technical specifications -- renders: technical specifications table and details
Customer reviews section frame -- renders: Customer Reviews heading, rating histogram, and review filter controls; excludes individual review content and user-uploaded images
